dedupe_keys.name: ofca location of registered wifi access points public wifi hotspots in hong kong by provider and frequency band

description: This dataset lists the registered public WiFi access points that licensees authorised under the Telecommunications Ordinance (Cap. 106) to provide public WiFi service have reported to OFCA. Each point gives the facility category, the service provider, the address and district in English and Chinese, the frequency bands in use, an access point identification, and Hong Kong 1980 grid easting and northing as well as latitude and longitude; the current layer holds 5,024 points. It is published on the government open data portal as an API pointing to the Common Spatial Data Infrastructure (CSDI) portal, where it is available as an ArcGIS feature service, WFS, WMS and GeoJSON. Coverage: Hong Kong. Format and access: web services and GeoJSON, free under the DATA.GOV.HK terms with attribution. Caveats: only fixed-location registered access points of licensed providers; the portal metadata date is June 2024, so recent additions may be missing, and the count covers only the published layer. Simulation uses: locating public connectivity points for emergency communication planning and for estimating how much public access survives a power or backhaul outage in a district. Related records: the OFCA communications open data give key statistics on public WiFi, and the OFCA DTT coverage database gives building-level broadcast coverage.
